scope.scope_correction: The earlier Issue #472 description called these rows remaining residuals, but the target IDs exactly match Issue #469. This artifact treats the work as a second-pass source adjudication against the current main closure, not as new row coverage.

source_evidence_catalog.source_title: 《中州派紫微斗数深造讲义（下）》
source_evidence_catalog.excerpt: 若紫微无煞曜同度，却有辅佐吉曜同会，又见禄马交驰，或会廉贞化禄、贪狼化禄、武曲化禄者，主职掌财权。
source_evidence_catalog.finding: The three transformation carriers are source-explicit, but inner quantifier among the three named transformations is not explicit.

source_evidence_catalog.source_title: 《中州派紫微斗数深造讲义（上）》
source_evidence_catalog.excerpt: 太阳又为词讼及是非口舌之星，所以不宜见过多的刑曜，如擎羊、天刑、官符、白虎等。
source_evidence_catalog.finding: Examples marked by 如/等 support an open, non-exhaustive category, not a closed membership list.

source_evidence_catalog.source_title: 《中州派紫微斗数深造讲义（下）》
source_evidence_catalog.excerpt: 太阳亦喜三台八座，恩光天贵等杂曜朝拱，皆有助于事业。
source_evidence_catalog.finding: Two named pair surfaces occur under the open tail 等杂曜 and relation 朝拱; this alone does not state the outer list quantifier.

source_evidence_catalog.source_title: 《中州派紫微斗数深造讲义（上）》
source_evidence_catalog.excerpt: 三台属阳土，八座属阴土，均为仪仗之星，必须成对会照，然后才主增高地位。
source_evidence_catalog.finding: Explicitly supports pair-internal BOTH for 三台/八座 only.

source_evidence_catalog.source_title: 《中州派紫微斗数深造讲义（上）》
source_evidence_catalog.excerpt: 以上十对星曜，多需成对同会然后始有力量。
source_evidence_catalog.finding: Supports pair-section reading for named pairs including 恩光/天贵; it does not prove ANY/ALL across the list of pair patterns.

source_evidence_catalog.source_title: 《中州派紫微斗数深造讲义（下）》
source_evidence_catalog.excerpt: 武曲与火铃同度，则不喜更落于巳午二宫，亦不喜多见属火的星曜，否则一生至少有一次卸职或失业。
source_evidence_catalog.finding: Preserve the open property category 属火的星曜 and the nonnumeric cardinal phrase 多见.

source_evidence_catalog.source_title: 《中州派紫微斗数深造讲义（下）》
source_evidence_catalog.excerpt: 武破在事业宫，与铃星、陀罗、阴煞、华盖、天刑同度者，为偏门或半偏行业。
source_evidence_catalog.finding: Explicit five-item list without a reusable ANY/ALL/N_OF quantifier.

source_evidence_catalog.source_title: 《中州派紫微斗数深造讲义（下）》
source_evidence_catalog.excerpt: 天同巨门可从事饮食业，见天厨、火星同度者尤然。
source_evidence_catalog.finding: Two named stars are listed, but the sentence does not define a transferable list quantifier.

source_evidence_catalog.source_title: 《中州派紫微斗数深造讲义（下）》
source_evidence_catalog.excerpt: 唯武曲化忌，天厨、火星同度者，往往又主父母所业者带煞气，如饮食业之类。不见天厨，亦为操利器行业。
source_evidence_catalog.finding: The same source reuses 天厨、火星同度 as a conjunction tied to the food-industry manifestation and explicitly contrasts absence of 天厨, supporting pair-internal co-presence rather than an open list.

source_evidence_catalog.source_title: 《中州派紫微斗数深造讲义（下）》
source_evidence_catalog.excerpt: 武曲与天厨、火星同躔福德宫，其人擅长品评饮食。
source_evidence_catalog.finding: A further same-source occurrence uses the same two-star surface under 同躔, reinforcing local pair-internal BOTH semantics without establishing a global category rule.

source_evidence_catalog.source_title: 《中州派紫微斗数深造讲义（下）》
source_evidence_catalog.excerpt: 廉相会禄（武曲化禄为上，禄存次之），或会天府化科，宜握财权。
source_evidence_catalog.finding: Existing main closure correctly preserves ranked alternatives within 会禄 and explicit outer OR to 天府化科.

source_evidence_catalog.source_title: 《中州派紫微斗数深造讲义（下）》
source_evidence_catalog.excerpt: 卯酉宫廉贞破军必须见禄然后始主事业有成。以廉贞化禄事业较为顺遂。若破军化禄，则不但多劳，而且事业必有挫折。
source_evidence_catalog.finding: 见禄 is an explicitly necessary contextual shorthand; two local carriers are attested but not exhaustive, supporting a precise contextual LU blocker.

source_evidence_catalog.source_title: 《中州派紫微斗数深造讲义（下）》
source_evidence_catalog.excerpt: 天相守事业宫而为刑忌来会，更见煞曜同度，斗生牛马。有吉曜同会，亦时受压力。
source_evidence_catalog.finding: 刑忌来会 is preserved as a source pattern with unspecified internal binding; no specific 夹局 is asserted.

source_evidence_catalog.source_title: 《中州派紫微斗数深造讲义（上）》
source_evidence_catalog.excerpt: 另一个格局是刑忌夹印。天相相邻两宫，一见擎羊躔守、一见化忌躔守，即成为正格。
source_evidence_catalog.finding: A separate named pattern has explicit spatial binding, proving that generic 刑忌来会 must not be conflated with 刑忌夹印.

source_evidence_catalog.source_title: 《中州派紫微斗数深造讲义（下）》
source_evidence_catalog.excerpt: 与空劫同度，见吉辅者，创新之能力极强，此时却又喜昌曲相济。
source_evidence_catalog.finding: 吉辅 may be represented as a scoped qualified-support alias candidate, but membership/activation remain open.

records.source_condition_surface: 紫微无煞曜同度，有辅佐吉曜同会，又见禄马交驰，或会廉贞化禄、贪狼化禄、武曲化禄
records.normalized_expression: NEGATED_OPEN_CATEGORY(煞曜) AND QUALIFIED_CATEGORY(辅佐吉曜) AND [GROUP(禄马交驰) OR ENUMERATED_TRANSFORMS(廉贞化禄,贪狼化禄,武曲化禄; inner_quantifier=UNSPECIFIED)]
records.decision_zh: 原文在三项四化列表前有“或会”，但列表内部没有足够依据判定三项之间是 ANY、ALL 还是 N_OF。保留现有闭世界缺席与辅佐支持 blocker，并恢复列表量词 blocker。

records.normalized_expression: PRESENCE(OPEN_CATEGORY(刑曜; examples=擎羊|天刑|官符|白虎|...))
records.decision_zh: 中州派上册同样以“如……等”举例，支持非穷尽成员表；不把示例封闭成全集，也不把跨语境举例升级为全局激活规则。

records.source_condition_surface: 太阳见三台八座恩光天贵
records.normalized_expression: SOURCE_BRANCH_SET[PAIR_CO_PRESENT(三台,八座); PAIR_CO_PRESENT(恩光,天贵); OPEN_TAIL(等杂曜)]
records.decision_zh: 上册明确支持三台/八座及恩光/天贵的 pair-internal 成对语义；但没有明确授权把两组外层压成 ANY_OF 或 ALL_OF，且下册保留“等杂曜”开放尾项。因此只确认内部成对，不清除 SOURCE_LIST_QUANTIFIER_UNSPECIFIED 与 SOURCE_OPEN_TAIL_MEMBERSHIP_UNSPECIFIED。

records.source_condition_surface: 武曲与火铃同度且在巳午或多见火曜
records.normalized_expression: SAME_PALACE(武曲,GROUP(火铃)) AND [LOCATION(巳|午) OR CARDINAL_SOURCE_WORDING(多见,OPEN_PROPERTY_CATEGORY(属火的星曜))]
records.decision_zh: 按原文恢复“多见属火的星曜”；属性类别保持开放，“多见”不转成数值阈值。

records.source_condition_surface: 武曲破军与铃星陀罗阴煞华盖天刑同度
records.normalized_expression: SAME_PALACE_WITH_ENUMERATED_LIST(铃星,陀罗,阴煞,华盖,天刑; quantifier=UNSPECIFIED)
records.decision_zh: 五项显名列表仍未说明 ANY、ALL 或 N_OF；保留原 blocker。
本句单看标点仍可能有歧义，但同一来源在父母宫明确再次使用“天厨、火星同度”对应饮食业，并以“不见天厨”转向操利器行业；福德宫又见“天厨、火星同躔”对应饮食鉴赏。三处同源用法共同支持本句的 pair-internal BOTH。仅对这一本句结构作 source-local 解析，不建立任何全局“天厨火星”规则。

records.source_condition_surface: 廉相会禄（武曲化禄为上，禄存次之），或会天府化科
records.normalized_expression: ANY_OF[TRANSFORM(武曲,化禄), ATOM(禄存), TRANSFORM(天府,化科)]
records.decision_zh: 当前 main closure 已包含会禄内部武曲化禄/禄存的有序备选，以及外层“或会天府化科”；本轮只确认既有处理，不重复计为新解锁。

records.source_condition_surface: 卯酉廉贞破军必须见禄
records.normalized_expression: EXPLICIT_NECESSITY(PRESENCE(CONTEXTUAL_LU_SHORTHAND; attested=廉贞化禄|破军化禄; exhaustive=false))
records.decision_zh: 原文明确“必须见禄”，邻句只展示廉贞化禄与破军化禄的局部实现，并未声明穷尽成员。将宽泛 SOURCE_SHORTHAND blocker 收窄为现有 LU_SHORTHAND_CONTEXTUAL_UNRESOLVED；不建立全局见禄成员表。

records.source_condition_surface: 天相为刑忌来会且煞曜同度
records.normalized_expression: CO_OCCURRENCE(SOURCE_PATTERN(刑忌来会; binding=UNSPECIFIED)) AND SAME_PALACE(CLOSED_CATEGORY(煞曜); activation=UNRESOLVED)
records.decision_zh: 来源的“刑忌来会”不能偷换成上册定义的特定“刑忌夹印”；当前 closure 保留 source-compound 与 closed-category activation blockers。

records.source_condition_surface: 破军与空劫同度且见吉辅
records.normalized_expression: SAME_PALACE(GROUP(空劫)) AND PRESENCE(QUALIFIED_SUPPORT_ALIAS(吉辅; scope=local; membership_or_activation=open))
records.decision_zh: “吉辅”可作为本句的限定性辅助支持别名候选，但成员范围和激活量词仍开放；不将它扩展成全局词典规则。
